category.name: Automation and integration platforms
category.description: One connection that exposes thousands of third-party app actions to an agent, with managed auth.

entries.name: Activepieces
entries.free_tier: free: open-source, self-hostable at no cost; cloud free plan gives 100 credits/day, no card required
entries.desc_en: Build, run and manage no-code flows across 400+ apps via REST API or the built-in MCP server.
entries.notes: MCP server URL is per-instance (https://your-instance.com/mcp); OAuth-based client auth, and connection secrets/API keys are never exposed through MCP tools.

free_plan.quota: 100 credits per day, unlimited flows; free plan lists MCPs and API access

entries.name: Arcade.dev
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>; tool auth uses managed per-provider OAuth (e.g. GitHub, Google)
entries.free_tier: free tier: 2,000 auth events + 2,000 tool calls/mo, no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Execute authorized tool calls (GitHub, Slack, Google, etc.) with managed OAuth via API, SDK, or 200+ MCP servers.
entries.notes: First use of an OAuth-gated tool requires the human to approve a browser consent screen; token is then reused automatically. Team plan adds $0.10/auth event and $0.01/tool call beyond free quota.

entries.name: Composio
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>; per-toolkit connections use managed OAuth
entries.free_tier: free tier: 100,000 tool calls + 50,000 trigger events/mo, no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Discover, authorize and execute actions across 1,500+ SaaS toolkits through a unified API, SDK, or MCP session.
entries.notes: Free plan hard-caps usage with no overage billing; Scale plan ($29/mo) adds per-call overage pricing ($0.0003/tool call).

free_plan.quota: 100,000 tool calls + 50,000 trigger events, 3 team members

rate_limits.summary: 2,000 req/min on Free, up to 10,000 req/min on higher plans

entries.name: Gumloop
entries.free_tier: 14-day free trial of Pro (20,000 credits), requires credit card, no permanent free tier
entries.desc_en: Create AI agents, start chat sessions, and trigger no-code automations via REST API, SDKs, or the Gumloop MCP server.
entries.notes: Added: missing from the candidate list but a widely used AI-native automation builder with an official API, SDKs, and hosted MCP server. Trial converts to paid Pro ($37/mo) unless cancelled.

free_plan.quota: 14-day Pro trial (20,000 credits), one-time, converts to paid unless cancelled

async_jobs.how: Runs start asynchronously; webhook triggers return {success:true} immediately, results via run history/tools

entries.name: IFTTT API
entries.free_tier: no free-plan access; Webhooks/API require Pro plan ($2.99+/mo)
entries.desc_en: Fire a webhook event to trigger pre-configured Applets that act in connected consumer apps (Pro plan required).
entries.notes: Weaker fit than other entries: an agent can only fire events for Applets a human already built in the IFTTT UI (no dynamic/generic action catalog like Zapier), free plan excludes Webhooks entirely, and the Platform/Connect API is aimed at building new IFTTT services, not calling existing consumer integrations.

free_plan.quota: Free plan (2 Applets) exists but Webhooks require Pro ($2.99/mo); Make a web request needs Pro+

auth_scheme.format: Webhooks key in URL path: https://maker.ifttt.com/trigger/{event}/with/key/{key}; Connect API: IFTTT-Service-Key header

entries.name: Keboola Storage API
entries.auth_hint: X-StorageApi-Token: <STORAGE_API_TOKEN>; remote MCP uses OAuth sign-in
entries.free_tier: Free plan: 1 project, 120 compute minutes in the first month then 60 minutes/month, extra-small Snowflake backend; no credit card
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent load and query tables, create SQL and Python transformations, and trigger data pipeline jobs in a Keboola project.
entries.notes: Remote MCP URL is region-specific (https://mcp.<region>.keboola.com/mcp, e.g. mcp.eu-central-1.keboola.com); a local server is available from github.com/keboola/mcp-server. Jobs consume the monthly compute minutes; inactive accounts out of credits are suspended after 2 months. Developer docs: https://developers.keboola.com/.

free_plan.quota: 1 project; 120 compute minutes in first month, then 60 minutes/month

entries.name: Make API / MCP
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 operations/mo; most REST API endpoints require a paid plan
entries.desc_en: Trigger and manage Make automation scenarios, or call MCP tools, via REST API and a native MCP server/client.
entries.notes: MCP Server and MCP Client are included free on all Make plans; you pay only for operations consumed when scenarios run. Most REST API endpoints are reserved for paid subscriptions.

free_plan.quota: Free plan: up to 1,000 credits/month, 2 active scenarios; Make API access only on Core and higher

async_jobs.how: MCP scenario-run tools return after 25-40 s; longer runs continue (up to 40 min) and results are fetched by executionId

entries.name: Merge (Agent Handler)
entries.free_tier: free tier: 2,000 monthly credits for evaluation; production usage needs a paid Starter/Business/Enterprise plan
entries.desc_en: Give an agent governed, audited tool access to Salesforce, Slack, Jira and 100+ enterprise apps via API or MCP.
entries.notes: Separate product from Merge's classic Unified API (HRIS/ATS/CRM sync); Agent Handler is the AI-agent-facing tool-calling layer. Paid tier starts around $650/mo for 10 linked accounts, then per-account pricing.

free_plan.quota: 2,000 credits, unlimited registered users and tool packs (prototyping/testing)

entries.name: n8n API
entries.free_tier: free, self-hosted (open source, unlimited); n8n Cloud offers a paid-plan trial
entries.desc_en: Create, run and monitor n8n workflows via REST API, and expose or consume tools through MCP trigger/client nodes.
entries.notes: REST API manages workflows/executions/credentials/users, not per-node business logic. MCP support is a first-party node (MCP Server Trigger / MCP Client Tool) inside a running n8n instance, not a single hosted vendor endpoint. Non-Enterprise API keys have full account access; scoped keys need Enterprise plan.

free_plan.quota: Self-hosted Community Edition is free; Cloud trial (1,000 executions) has no API access

entries.name: Nango
entries.free_tier: free tier: 10 connections, 10 compute hours, 10GB data transfer/mo
entries.desc_en: Authorize end users to 400+ third-party APIs/MCP servers and proxy authenticated calls to them from your app or agent.
entries.notes: Nango is primarily an auth/proxy broker (open source, self-hostable) rather than itself an MCP server; its 'MCP Auth' feature lets your app authorize users to OTHER vendors' MCP servers (Notion, HubSpot, etc.) and call them via Nango's proxy. Free self-hosting is not offered outside the Enterprise (BYOC) plan.

free_plan.quota: 10 connections, 10 compute hours, 10GB data transfer; hard-capped

entries.name: Paragon ActionKit
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token>; connected accounts use managed OAuth
entries.free_tier: free experimentation tier with self-serve keys; production/scale pricing is usage-based or contract
entries.desc_en: Call thousands of pre-built Tools and Triggers across 130+ SaaS apps (Slack, Salesforce, Gmail) via API or MCP.
entries.notes: ActionKit specifically has a self-serve free tier for experimentation; Paragon's broader embedded-iPaaS platform is contract/sales-only with no public self-serve tier. ActionKit MCP uses SSE transport and is listed on the Anthropic MCP registry.

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer <Paragon User Token (JWT signed with project signing key)>

entries.name: Pipedream Connect
entries.free_tier: check pricing (pipedream.com/pricing) for current Connect free-tier request/credit limits
entries.desc_en: Call 2,700+ app APIs and run managed-auth actions on end users' behalf via REST API or Pipedream MCP servers.
entries.notes: Requires a Pipedream project plus client ID/secret/project ID to call the MCP server; managed auth handles end-user OAuth for connected apps.

free_plan.quota: Free plan: daily credit limit; Connect free in development environment with limited connected accounts

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (client credentials via POST https://api.pipedream.com/v1/oauth/token)

rate_limits.summary: Connect API: create token 100/min per external user; accounts 2,000/5 min and components 3,000/5 min per project

entries.name: StackOne
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 action-call credits/seat/mo (Starter), no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Call 500+ SaaS integrations (HRIS, ATS, CRM, documents) through one unified API or MCP gateway covering 27,000+ actions.
entries.notes: Beyond the free 1,000 credits/seat, Starter bills $0.003/extra call; Core and Enterprise tiers are quote-based (contact sales).

free_plan.quota: Starter: 1,000 credits per seat (1 tool/API call = 1 credit)

entries.name: Superglue
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <api_key> (exact header not independently confirmed - verify in docs)
entries.free_tier: free tier: Pro plan free to start, 3,000 executions/mo and 5M tokens/mo included, self-serve signup
entries.desc_en: Connect and orchestrate enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, databases) through a self-serve API and per-integration MCP servers.
entries.notes: Added: open-source, self-serve integration/migration agent for enterprise systems (NetSuite, SAP, Sage Intacct, Dynamics) with per-app MCP servers; some exact API details (auth header, SDK) could not be independently confirmed in this pass and should be double-checked in the live docs before use.

free_plan.quota: 3,000 executions and 5M tokens per month; open-source self-hosted version has no usage limits

entries.name: Zapier MCP / AI Actions
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <connection_token> (OAuth auto-configured for listed clients like Claude/ChatGPT)
entries.free_tier: Zapier Free plan (100 tasks/mo) covers MCP tool calls; more on paid plans
entries.desc_en: Call 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ pre-built actions (Slack, Gmail, Sheets, etc.) through one MCP endpoint.
entries.notes: "AI Actions"/Natural Language Actions is deprecated; Zapier now steers agents to Zapier MCP. Tool calls consume the same 'tasks' quota as regular Zaps.

free_plan.quota: 100 tasks/month; each successful MCP tool call uses 2 tasks

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer <CONNECTION_TOKEN> (or OAuth inside the MCP client)
